summary.tldr: Requires the Public Safety Minister to create a national framework for silver alerts for missing vulnerable older persons.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness to develop a national framework for a coordinated silver alert system across Canada.
Requires the minister to consult provinces, territories, police forces, alert issuers, and care providers when developing the framework.
Calls for the framework to make silver alerts more consistent across Canada, including use of existing public alert systems such as wireless alerts.
Calls for common rules on when a silver alert can be issued, to limit inappropriate alerts and allow targeted or inter-provincial alerts.
Requires privacy rules for personal information in alerts, plus public education, a report to Parliament within one year, and a review within two years.
summary.background: A silver alert is an emergency notification used to alert the public about a missing vulnerable older person, including a person with dementia.
